newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BP wins India Feb gasoline tender at under +$5/bbl.
newsitem.headline: BP wins India Feb gasoline tender at under +$5/bbl.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought through tender 25,000 tonnes of 87-octane leaded gasoline from major British Petroleum & Co Plc at almost $5.00 per barrel over Singapore 92-octane unleaded quotes, cost-and-freight Goa/Kandla on the west coast for February 15-29, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender closed January 22 and was valid until January 24.
Traders said IOC's last import tender for a similar cargo for delivery February 8-12 was won by a Dutch trader at a premium of more than $2.00 per barrel over Singapore 92-octane unleaded quotes.
IOC has another gasoline tender for February 21-25 delivery to the same ports which closes January 29 and valid until January 31.
